concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-verification-requirements-reference-additional-products-brand-specific-industry-codes]] — 2026-09-15 brand-specific IC/MCC classification and conditional approval-contact guide for Platforms business accounts; the pinned export has no accepted-code list or eligibility proof.
warnings: The pinned raw says only listed brand-specific IC values are accepted but contains no actual list/table; do not infer a code or brand mapping from it.

Adyen contact/Support escalation is conditional on needing pre-onboarding code approval or entering a new industry for business accounts; this snapshot does not itself grant approval or a business-account capability.
